item.title: Finalist at Youth Tech Begin 2025
item.description:
We are thrilled to share that Khaled and his team were selected as finalists at Youth Tech Begin 2025, a flagship entrepreneurship event organized under the Karınca GO Acceleration Program at Medeniyet Teknopark, Istanbul.

Their project introduces a next-generation point-of-care diagnostic biosensor, designed to detect multiple biomarkers from a single drop of blood. Combining engineering design, biomedical insight, and computational intelligence, the system offers compact and rapid health diagnostics—tailored for real-world impact.

“Being part of this journey alongside such a passionate team has been an honor. We’re excited about what lies ahead.” — Khaled

Special thanks to the organizers, mentors, and jury members for cultivating a platform that celebrates innovation and global collaboration among youth.

Team Members:

  • Mohmmed Salah
  • Mohammed Hussein
  • Khaled HAMIDI KENO
  • Hashem Saeed Ahmed Abdo Al-Goami
  • Radwan Alaiany
  • Yusuf M.
  • Abdulfattah Alsabri

Social Media Highlights:

نُبارك للفريق على هذا الإنجاز، حيث تأهّل مشروعهم إلى نهائيات مسابقة Youth Tech Begin 2025 في إسطنبول، بتنظيم من منصة Karınca GO داخل تكنوبارك جامعة مدنيّت.

المشروع يمثّل جيلًا جديدًا من أجهزة التشخيص السريع، باستخدام حساسات كهروكيميائية على ورق ميكروفلويدي، لقياس مؤشرات حيوية من قطرة دم واحدة. يدمج النظام بين هندسة الإلكترونيات، والتحليل الطبي، والذكاء الحاسوبي.

مزيد من النجاح والتقدم للفريق المبدع في رحلتهم الريادية نحو تحسين الرعاية الصحية عالميًا.

item.title: Success Story | Khaled Hamidi – From Adversity to the Summit
item.description:
In June 2025 Dr. Musab Al-Shebib — a Syrian researcher and academic — chose engineer Khaled Hamidi to inaugurate his new “Success Stories” series.
The recorded conversation traces Khaled’s path from shattered classrooms in Syria, through the hurdles of life as a refugee in Türkiye, to graduating first in Mechatronics Engineering at Karabuk University’s Faculty of Technology.

Key moments covered in the interview:

  • Growing up amid conflict and studying under the roar of war-planes rather than school bells.
  • Crossing into Türkiye with little more than determination — and hundreds of unanswered questions.
  • Overcoming the language barrier, mastering Turkish, and turning exile into motivation rather than limitation.
  • Achieving rank #1 in Karabuk University’s Faculty of Technology (Mechatronics).

“Khaled refused to be just a statistic on a refugee list; instead, he became number one on the list of excellence.” — Dr. Musab Al-Shebib

Below is the full video interview as published on Dr. Al-Shebib’s Facebook page.

Turkish Summary | Bir Başarı Hikayesi

Zorlukların arttığı bir dönemde, Halid Hamidi’nin hikâyesi en ilham verici örneklerden biri oldu.
Suriye’de savaş ortamında eğitimine başlayan Halid, Türkiye’ye sığınmacı olarak geldi.
Türkçeyi kısa sürede öğrenerek Karabük Üniversitesi Mekatronik Mühendisliği bölümünde birinci olmayı başardı.
Bu sadece bir diploma değil; azmin ve iradenin zaferidir.

Message to readers: Circumstances can be harsher than imagined, yet steadfast willpower ultimately prevails.

item.title: Khaled Honored at Karabuk University Technology Faculty Graduation
item.description:
On 17 May 2025, Khaled returned to Karabuk University to join the Technology Faculty’s graduation ceremony.
During the proceedings he was formally recognized as the Faculty’s top graduate and invited to deliver the commencement address.
The distinction crowns a year of accelerated academic achievement and reflects his dedication to innovation and service.

“I came only to share my friends’ joy and to remind everyone that every success is the fruit of collective support.” — Khaled

Khaled dedicated the honor to his parents—whose steadfast encouragement sustained him—along with his professors, colleagues, and friends whose guidance illuminated his path.
He expressed special gratitude to Karabuk University for the thoughtful invitation that allowed him to celebrate, once more, alongside the class of 2025.

في 17 مايو 2025، عاد خالد إلى جامعة كارابوك للمشاركة في حفل تخرّج كلية التكنولوجيا.
وخلال الحفل، كرّمته الجامعة بصفته الأوّل على الكلية، ومنحته شرف إلقاء كلمة الخريجين.
يُعدّ هذا التقدير تتويجًا لعامٍ من التفوّق المتسارع، ويعكس التزامه بالابتكار وخدمة مجتمعه.

«ما جئتُ إلا لأشارك أحبّتي فرحتهم، ولأقول إن كلَّ نجاحٍ هو ثمرةُ دعمكم.» — خالد

أهدى خالد هذا التكريم لوالديه، مصدر الدعم اللامتناهـي، ولأساتذته وزملائه وأصدقائه الذين كانوا دليلًا ونورًا لمسيرته.
وأعرب عن امتنانه لجامعة كارابوك على الدعوة الكريمة التي أتاحت له مشاركة فرحة دفعة 2025 من جديد.

item.title: Started Master’s Studies at Gaziantep University
item.description:
Khaled HAMIDI has officially embarked on a new academic journey by joining the Master’s program in Aerospace Engineering at Gaziantep University.

This step marks a strategic move to deepen his expertise in aerodynamics, spacecraft systems, and computational modeling—laying the groundwork for advanced interdisciplinary research and real-world innovation.

He expressed gratitude to those who supported his path, emphasizing that this milestone is not a destination, but a launchpad toward impactful research and future contributions in the aerospace field.

item.title: Rector’s Commendation for Khaled’s TÜBİTAK 2209A Research Excellence | تكريم خالد من رئيس جامعة كارابوك عن مشروع TÜBİTAK 2209A
item.description:
Honored by Karabuk University Rector

On 30 May 2024, at the Hamit Çepni Conference Hall, Khaled was presented with a certificate of appreciation by Karabuk University’s Rector, Prof. Dr. Fatih KIRIŞIK. The occasion honored students and advisors whose projects were accepted in the 2023 second-term TÜBİTAK 2209 A-B program, a highly competitive initiative coordinated by the Technology Transfer Office to spotlight the university’s leading research and innovation efforts.

Khaled’s project, selected under the TÜBİTAK 2209A scheme, underscores his exceptional research acumen and the potential impact of his work. The recognition also reflects the university’s commitment to fostering talent and advancing scientific knowledge. Khaled expressed gratitude to the administration, faculty, and fellow researchers for their unwavering support and affirmed his resolve to contribute further to cutting-edge inquiry.

item.title: ASP.NET Hackathon Winner Order Management System
item.description:
ASP.NET Hackathon Winner: Khaled’s Order Management System.

In a remarkable achievement, I emerged as the winner of a prestigious hackathon organized by Karabuk University’s SAVUNMA TEKNOLOJİLERİ KULÜBÜ (Defense Technologies Club) and sponsored by Enoca. The intense hackathon event lasted from 5 PM until 6 AM the following morning, attracting over 100 talented competitors.

Order Management System (OMS)

Khaled’s winning project was an Order Management System (OMS) built using cutting-edge technologies and following industry best practices. The system was developed using the following techniques:

  • ASP.NET Core 6 API
  • Repository Service Pattern
  • MSSQL Code FIRST
  • N-Tier Architecture
  • API Endpoint URL structure Best Practices
  • Entity Framework Core
  • Global Error Handling
  • Custom Action Filter
  • Login System Authentication and Authorization (for master, company, and guest users)
  • Global Error Handling
  • Caching
  • Migrations (Project.Data)

The project was structured following the N-Tier architecture pattern, with the following components:

  • Project.API - Presentation Layer (.NET Core Web API project)
  • Project.Core
  • Project.Data
  • Project.Service
  • Project.Common

Design Patterns and Architectural Principles

The Order Management System exemplified best practices in software design and architecture, incorporating the following patterns and principles:

  • CQRS Design Pattern, utilizing Mediatr and Onion Architecture
  • Custom Repositories on default repositories with Data Transfer Object (DTO) for Queries and Commands
  • AutoMapper
  • Unit of Work Pattern
